summary: Pasqal integrated NVIDIA CUDA-Q with its QRMI runtime so Slurm can schedule workloads on Pasqal quantum systems.
quote: PARIS, March 16, 2026 — Pasqal, a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing and member of the NVIDIA Inception program for startups, announced today the integration of the NVIDIA CUDA-Q platform with its Quantum Resource Management Interface (QRMI) runtime.
